basic_details.job_title: RGCB Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Applications are invited from suitable candidates (Indian Citizens) for one position of Junior Research Fellow under the CSIR-ASPIRE Project titled "Preclinical Studies on Targeting Beta-hCG as a Treatment Strategy for BRCA1 Promoter Hypermethylated Breast Cancers", in the laboratory of Dr. Priya Srinivas, Scientist G & Dean at the Rajiv Gandhi Centre for Biotechnology (BRIC-RGCB), Thiruvananthapuram. Applications should be submitted online.

how_to_apply: Candidates currently working in Government firms should send applications through proper channel.
Ensure that all applications are in the prescribed format.
If a candidate wishes to apply for different positions, separate application forms should be submitted for each position.
important_instructions: Applications which are not in the prescribed format will summarily be rejected. Only those fulfilling the above criteria need apply. Candidates currently working in Government firms should send applications through proper channel. If a candidate wishes to apply for different positions, separate application forms should be submitted for each position. Selection to the position will not entitle the candidate to any future positions at RGCB (permanent or otherwise). As with all project positions at RGCB, the position will be co terminus with the end of the project.

content_sections.heading: About RGCB Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: The Rajiv Gandhi Centre for Biotechnology (BRIC-RGCB), located in Thiruvananthapuram, is an autonomous institute of the Department of Biotechnology, Government of India. This recruitment is for a temporary project position under a CSIR-ASPIRE research scheme focused on breast cancer preclinical studies.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfil the essential qualification requirements to be eligible for the Junior Research Fellow position.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Junior Research Fellow will receive a monthly emolument of ₹ 37,000/- + 16% HRA per month. The appointment is initially for a period of one year or till termination of the project whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RGCB Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Applications should be submitted online. Candidates currently working in Government firms should send applications through proper channel. Ensure that all applications are in the prescribed format. If a candidate wishes to apply for different positions, separate application forms should be submitted for each position.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants will be short listed for the online selection interview based on eligibility criteria. Selection of suitable candidates will be made based on qualifications and performance in the selection interview. Selection to the position will not entitle the candidate to any future positions at RGCB (permanent or otherwise). As with all project positions at RGCB, the position will be co terminus with the end of the project.
